 RRB Allahabad Group D Result 2026 - The Railway Recruitment Board will release the RRB Group D results 2026 on its official website: rrb.indianrailways.gov.in. The RRB is the exam-conducting authority for the RRB Group D exam all over the country. The result of the RRB Group D 2026 recruitment will be released online in PDF format, containing the roll numbers of the selected applicants.

 RRB Group D Allahabad Result 2026
 RRB declares the result for every stage of the Group D recruitment exam, and applicants need to clear each stage to be eligible to appear in the subsequent rounds. The final RRB Allahabad Group D result will be prepared on the basis of applicants' performance in the CBT, PET, and document verification rounds. To know more about the RRB Allahabad Group D result 2026 in detail, see the article below.

 How to Check RRB Allahabad Group D Result 2026
 The RRB Allahabad Group D result is released online on the RRB Allahabad website. Aspirants can follow the steps below to check their RRB Group D result 2026.
 Visit the official RRB Allahabad website – rrb.indianrailways.gov.in
 Click on the link given on the website to check the RRB Allahabad Group D result 2026
 A PDF file will appear on the screen, with the roll number of the selected aspirants
 Use Ctrl+F to search your roll number
 Download and save the RRB Allahabad Group D 2026 result for future reference

 Details Printed On The RRB Allahabad Group D Result 2026
 The RRB Allahabad Group D result contains the roll numbers of qualified candidates in PDF format. Along with the result, the scorecard for the RRB Group D is also released on the RRB Allahabad website.
 RRB Allahabad Group D Result 2026 - CBT
 Applicants qualifying for the CBT stage are eligible for the PET round. The minimum marks required for qualifying for the CBT round are prescribed by the RRB beforehand. Aspirants need to attain the minimum marks required or more to qualify for the computer-based test and be eligible for the physical efficiency test.
 RRB Allahabad Group D Result 2026 - Score Calculation
 RRB Group D results are released by the authorities on their official website – rrb.indianrailways.gov.in for all the stages of the RRB Group D recruitment. The RRB Group D exam has one written round, i.e., a computer-based test only. The score calculation formula for the CBT stage is given below.
 Total Score for CBT = Total number of right answers x 1 – Total number of wrong answers x 1/3
 RRB Allahabad Group D Result 2026 - Final Result
 The final result of RRB Group D recruitment is based on the performance of the applicants in all three stages of the selection process – CBT, PET, and document verification. The final merit list is released in PDF format for the selected candidates. The final merit list will contain the roll numbers of the selected applicants.
 RRB Group D Result 2026 - Region-wise
 As the RRB Group D result is released region-wise for all the RRBs, aspirants appearing for the same exam but from a different region can check their RRB Group D result 2026 by visiting the regional website of that region or by clicking on the links in the table below.

 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
 Q: Does RRB Allahabad release the scorecard for the RRB Group D exam? A: Yes, the scorecard for the RRB Allahabad Group D 2026 result is released by the authorities.
 Q: How many stages are there in the RRB Group D recruitment exam? A: There are three stages in the RRB Group D exam recruitment process i.e CBT, PET and document verification
 Q: How can I check my RRB Allahabad Group D result? A: Applicants can check their RRB Allahabad Group D result on the RRB Allahabad official website.
 Q: What is the minimum educational qualification required for the RRB Group D exam? A: The minimum educational requirement for the Group D exam is 10th or 12th passed.
